name: aura-dims-monorepos
description: Aura Digital Information Management System (Aura DIMS) - Monorepo foundation
author: Aurainteract Private Limited

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aura-dims/display-schema build && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/functions build && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/player build && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/web build
scripts.build:functions: pnpm --filter @aura-dims/display-schema build && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/display-schema pack --pack-destination functions && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/functions build
scripts.deploy:staging:hosting: pnpm --filter @aura-dims/web build:staging && firebase deploy --only hosting -P staging
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:rules && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/functions build && pnpm --filter @aura-dims/web build:staging && firebase deploy -P staging
